purpose: Describe outward signs of another person’s feelings.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Adjective stem + がる; ongoing signs + がっている.
The child is showing fear of the dark room.
My younger brother wants new shoes.
The dog wants to go outside.
formation: Adjective stem + がる; ongoing signs + がっている.
restrictions: Usually reports observed behavior rather than claiming direct access to someone’s feelings.
mistake: Use 欲しがる for observed wanting; speaker desire normally uses 欲しい.
